name: omp-cliproxy-usage
description: omp plugin: real token cost and subscription quota for models served through CLIProxyAPI with the cliproxy-costs plugin
author: Alex Markessinis <alex@markessinis.me>

provider.description: omp provider id (models.yml) that points at CLIProxyAPI

baseUrl.description: CLIProxyAPI root URL; default = the provider base URL without a trailing /v1

managementKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the CLIProxyAPI management key (cliproxy-costs data is served under CPA's management API)

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable NAME of the provider's inference key (same value as models.yml apiKey); required for rates and quota

rates.description: Rate source: cliproxy-costs (with snapshot/feed fallback), the public feed only, or no pricing

feedUrl.description: Pricing feed used as the last fallback

aliases.description: JSON object mapping model id -> "<catalog provider>/<catalog model>" for the feed fallback

reconcile.description: Look up what CLIProxyAPI recorded for each request of the session and show it next to omp's estimate

staleAfterMinutes.description: Quota observations older than this are shown as stale

startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time the extension waits for rates at startup

driftWarnPct.description: Warn once per session when omp's estimate and CLIProxyAPI's recorded cost differ by more than this percentage

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the plugin's status, widget and report (e.g. EUR, CNY); empty = the CLIProxyAPI display currency. omp's own costs stay USD
